description: Get how the rubric was applied to your submission: points and comment for each criterion, plus your score. Read-only. Returns no assessment if the instructor did not grade with a rubric. get_rubric_assessment returns the same data plus the compact rubric_assessment form.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: get_my_rubric_assessment
title: Get My Rubric Assessment
